pat: quick brain dump re: form errors + delete confirmations in the console. dropped 3 compact sketches in figma: soft-undo, confirm-checkbox, typed-confirm. any quick takes? https://www.figma.com/file/zzz pat: also adding required marker variants — explicit '(required)' vs asterisk + legend. curious which to use by default. kai: soft-undo is lowest friction. typed-confirm feels like a nuclear option but ok for PII or when many downstream hooks exist. emma: for long forms i vote explicit '(required)' on labels. asterisk is too ambiguous for users unfamiliar with the legend. emma: inline errors should be short and show an example: e.g., 'Name required (3-100 chars)'. avoid long paragraphs. vic: accessibility: if you use typed-confirm, ensure aria-describedby points to the instruction and announce the expected string. also the undo snackbar needs role="status" and should be keyboard-focusable. pat: proposal: hybrid rule in components doc: if item.sensitive || selectedCount > 3 || downstreamImpact > 0 => typed-confirm. else soft-undo. kai: sounds good. also add a behavior for bulk: if user hits undo after autoscheduler has fired, show a mitigation modal explaining next steps. emma: error summary UX: show top summary only when 3+ errors. summary should list fields and link to first invalid field for keyboard users. vic: snippet for aria-live:
Pipeline moved to Trash.
pat: i'll update figma with the hybrid rule, the explicit '(required)' defaults, and the snackbar copy 'Moved to Trash (recoverable 30 days) — Undo'. design-bot: reminder: add 'voiceover read-through' and 'keyboard-only undo' to checklist. :spiral_notepad: pat: thanks all, will ping after prototype.
